title: Sunday · phones on the seawall
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The seawall in August from behind a row of tourists, every one holding up a phone at the bay: the bay in the sky and the bay on twelve screens, the screens brighter.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a row of tourists from behind at the seawall, each holding a phone up at the bay, the bay above them gray and the bay on their screens bright blue.

image.prompt: a row of tourists seen from behind at a seawall each holding up a phone at a gray bay that appears bright blue on every screen, no words

panels.name: Row

panels.composition: Tier 2: one screen, close, the bay in it, saturated, a gull frozen mid-flap.

image.prompt: close on a phone screen showing a saturated blue bay with a gull frozen mid-flap, no words

panels.name: Screen

panels.composition: Tier 3: the bay, itself, gray, the gull gone. Held.

image.prompt: a gray bay with no gull, no words

panels.name: Bay

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Twelve bays, brighter. Then the one.
